title: skills: teach that an agent's model name is optional (follow-up of #37697)
body:
epic:#5055#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMmczBEaeiAQ48oDtz

Filing gate: ② owed docs follow-up · Source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#37697 (`Skills-docs: follow-up owed`), implementing objectstack-ai/objectstack#37686 under epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5055.
Grade: p2 · area:ai · Task · evidence: read (PR #37697 diff; contract review comment 7204641048)
Reader: epic:#5055 seat → card thread.
Dedupe: follow-up of #37697 only.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：框架已允许 agent 省略模型名（#37697），但公开技能文档仍教“模型名必填”，评测题也按必填出。补上文档和评测。
- 影响：AI 写 agent 元数据时会照新规则写；不改代码。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What to do
1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` "Model Configuration": teach that `model.model` is optional and absent means the host's default model for the environment; fix the stale `agent.zod.ts` line citation.
2. `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json`: the case that expects "a free-string `model`" accepts an omitted model too.

## Acceptance
- Skill gates and evals per AGENTS.md green; the cited lines match `packages/spec/src/ai/agent.zod.ts` on main.

## Blocked-by
Blocked-by: #37697
